speech_verification.heard: King Henry VIII watched his favorite warship capsize in minutes. The Merry Rose sank during the Battle of the Solent. A survivor testified that the turning ship healed in the wind. Water poured through lower gunports left open after firing. Anti-boarding netting then trapped nearly 500 men below. Centuries later, the recovered wreck reveals why King Henry VIII watched his favorite warship capsize in minutes.
